title: MEDUSA: Maintaining Entire DNA Duplexes for Utmost Sequencing Accuracy
boundary: Staged repair/blunting followed by nucleotide-pool destruction with apyrase, then restricted dA-tailing, limits resynthesis before duplex-UMI ligation. Distinct reagent-pool transition from ddBTP chain-termination protection in HiDEF-seq and restriction-defined NanoSeq input; not proposed merely for another fragmentation enzyme or specimen. Exact precursor overlap needs source curation.
evidence_scope: PublishedApril2026/issueJuly2026 primary publisher identity/abstract and indexed workflow overview plus PubMed42300967 identity checked. Earlier MEDUSA preprint PMID41279628 identified as superseded and excluded as active chemistry authority. Publisher full-page request gated; no bypass, supplement/full chemistry audit or collection count.

title: Enzyme-assisted high throughput sequencing of an expanded genetic alphabet at single base resolution
boundary: Differential cytidine deamination and expanded-triphosphate PCR transliterate synthetic six-letter ACGTZP templates into conventional bases for deep sequencing. This changes the encoded alphabet and molecular conversion/copying path, rather than a target panel or polymerase variant; polymerase screens and functionalized-base tests stay branches. Different purpose/substrate from methylation EM-seq.
evidence_scope: PublishedMay2024 primary Nature/PMC11094070 identity/abstract and selected conversion overview inspected. Superseded PMC10775363 preprint recognized and excluded; no preprint-only conditions adopted. NGS frontend is explicit, not solely Sanger. Full Methods/SI and expanded-base model requirements await curation.

title: Measuring genome-wide nucleosome turnover using CATCH-IT
boundary: Metabolic incorporation of azidohomoalanine into newly synthesized histones, covalent biotin click-tagging, native nucleosome digestion and streptavidin enrichment select associated DNA for paired-end sequencing. Different biochemical labeling/capture frontend from antibody ChIP/MINCE-seq DNA labeling and from SNAP-tag cohort labeling in time-ChIP.
evidence_scope: Published2012 primary MethodsEnzymology chapter identity/abstract explicitly includes paired-end Solexa library preparation; primary author2010 CellCycle overview10.4161/cc.9.17.13091 corroborates metabolic click/capture principle. Original2010 microarray discovery is not independently counted as an NGS protocol. Full chapter/supplement reading pending; no source acquisition.

title: Enhancer regions show high histone H3.3 turnover that changes during differentiation
boundary: A genetically SNAP-tagged histone cohort is pulse covalently biotinylated in cells, washed/chased and captured with its associated chromatin DNA for NGS. Selects the fate of a pre-existing labeled protein cohort rather than metabolic labeling of newly synthesized proteins in CATCH-IT; histone targets and differentiation conditions are branches.
evidence_scope: PublishedJune2016 primary eLife/PMC4965263 identity/abstract and initial SNAP-biotin workflow overview inspected; PubMed27304074 confirms defining DOI. Detailed2018 time-ChIP protocol10.1007/978-1-4939-8663-7_7 identified as same method, not another entry. No full recipe/SI or linked-source review.

title: Cistrome and Epicistrome Features Shape the Regulatory DNA Landscape
boundary: Affinity-tagged in-vitro-expressed TF captures a preconstructed native genomic-DNA fragment library, retaining endogenous methylation during binding before elution/amplification/NGS. Different molecular substrate/library-generation boundary from synthetic-random Bind-n-Seq/HT-SELEX and in-cell crosslink ChIP. TF/species panels are not entries; amplified-DNA and sequential-complex variants require comparison before any separate admission.
evidence_scope: PublishedMay2016 primary Cell summary/graphical overview and PubMed27203113 exact identity checked; primary2017 detailed DAP-seq protocol overview at PMC5576341 independently states native-library/capture principle. Linked2016 correction10.1016/j.cell.2016.08.063 discovered but not reviewed here; original/supplement/correction chemistry remains for capped curation.

title: Simultaneous sequencing of genetic and epigenetic bases in DNA
boundary: Hairpin ligation/splitting links each original sample strand to a newly synthesized unmodified copy; enzymatic protection/conversion and paired original-copy decoding preserve genetic information while encoding5mC/5hmC. Original-plus-copy substrate and enzymatic two-base code differ from Methyl-SNP bisulfite and original-Watson/Crick MASD/CODEC duplex preparations. Five/six-letter branches are one candidate; this is not ESEGA synthetic-ACGTZP alphabet sequencing.
evidence_scope: PublishedFebruary2023 primary Nature/PubMed36747096 identity/abstract and initial published workflow overview checked; PMC10567558 is the same published original. Prior MASD discovery mentioned five-letter only as comparator, not a queued entry; defining DOI absent. Source-specific copy/conversion and branch distinctions provisional pending full Methods/SI curation; no collection count.
